desc:
Start as a tiny hatchling and grow into a MASSIVE dragon! Eat your way up the food chain, breathe fire and take over the skies.

🥚 Hatch your egg and discover your element
🍖 Eat food and smaller dragons to grow bigger
🔥 Unleash your breath and burn through villages and castles
🧬 Unlock powerful new forms on the Dragon Tree
🪽 Evolve wings and take flight
💎 Discover rare elements, from Ice to Void
👑 Become the biggest dragon on the server!

Watch your back... there's always a bigger dragon.

👍 Enjoying the game? Like and favorite!
